title: Integral exceptional preservation on an affine chart
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $E$ a finite intermediate field of $\overline{\mathbb Q}_\ell/\mathbb Q_\ell$, $k$ a field of prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$ with its recorded condensed ring structure. Let $X$ and $Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism ([sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]). Write $\operatorname{Dbc}(T,\Lambda)$ for the bounded complexes with finite constant scalar constructible models ([sk-def-sfb-constructible]) and $\operatorname{Loc}(\operatorname{Dbc}(T,\Lambda))$ for their ordinary ambient localizing closure ([sk-def-localizing-closure]). Fix a boundary compactification $c$ of $f$, a witness that its actual compact-support composite $R f_!$ preserves these localizing closures, and any functor $G$ with an adjunction $R f_!\dashv G$ as in [det-prop-int-brown-adjoint]. Let $u:U\hookrightarrow X$ and $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$ be affine open inclusions with $U\subseteq f^{-1}(V)$. For every $K\in\operatorname{Loc}(\operatorname{Dbc}(Y,\Lambda))$ whose ambient object belongs to $\operatorname{Dbc}(Y,\Lambda)$, the actual derived restriction $u^*(G K)$ belongs to $\operatorname{Dbc}(U,\Lambda)$. No global preservation or finite-cover gluing hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: General f paragraph, local affine chart

proof.text: Apply lem-sfb-integral-exceptional-affine-factorization to construct the closed affine-space presentation and obtain Brown adjoints Gp, Gi and the object comparison u* G K ≅ Gi(Gp(v* K)). This step does not assume any constructibility preservation.

The constructible_pull clause of det-prop-int-brown-construction puts v* K in the constant-model bounded constructible subcategory. Apply the affine-space Brown comparison and preservation clauses of det-thm-int-restriction-line to Gp. Apply the support comparison and preservation clauses of det-thm-int-restriction-closed to Gi. Transfer constructibility across the comparison isomorphism; the private helpers prove isomorphism invariance directly from local scalar models and homology.

theorem integralExceptionalAffineChart (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f)
    (h : ∀ K, localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X K →
      localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y
        ((image (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.obj).obj K))
    (G : (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X).FullSubcategory)
    (_adj : lowerShriek (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.obj h ⊣ G)
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (_hU : IsAffineOpen U) (_hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (_hUV : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (K : (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y).FullSubcategory)
    (_hK : generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y K.obj) :
    generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) U.toScheme
      ((pull (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) U.ι).obj (G.obj K).obj)
